Ancient Orbs go unnamed in {{TotK}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Object |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = }} Ancient Orbs are spherical pieces of [[Ancient Technology]] constructed by the [[Sheikah]] 10,000 years ago. They come in two sizes. The first size is smaller, and Link is capable of moving them by picking them up. In addition, they come in a larger size which can be pushed, but usually must be moved by alternative means. Placing Ancient Orbs inside [[Concave Slot]]s will activate Ancient Technology, such as revealing [[Ancient Shrine]]s or opening doors. Several Ancient Orbs are given specific names. These Orbs are involved in [[Shrine Quest]]s throughout [[Hyrule]]. They are as follows: * The [[Grand Trophy]] is used in "[[The Undefeated Champ]]" Shrine Quest. * The [[Sacred Orb]] is used in the "[[EX Champion Urbosa's Song]]" [[Main Quest]], which is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] Pack. * The [[Sheikah Heirloom]] is used in "[[The Stolen Heirloom]]" Shrine Quest. * [[Roscoe]] is used in the "[[Guardian Slideshow]]" Shrine Quest. In addition, there are unnamed Ancient Orbs that are also involved in Shrine Quests. * During the "[[Into the Vortex]]" Shrine Quest, Link must bring an Ancient Orb from the base of [[Rist Peninsula]] all the way to its tip, where there is a Concave Slot.{{Cite|Only a hero bearing this {{Color BotW|Red|ancient orb}} shall be granted the right of {{Color BotW|Red|trial}} on Rist Peninsula.|Stone Tablet|BotW}} When this is done, [[Ritaag Zumo Shrine]] will emerge from the ground. * During the "[[Stranded on Eventide]]" Shrine Quest, Link must retrieve three Ancient Orbs throughout [[Eventide Island]] and place them in Concave Slots.{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Monk Blue|Offer up the orbs to the three altars on this island. Only then will I acknowledge your skill and return your items.}}|Korgu Chideh|BotW}} This will cause [[Korgu Chideh Shrine]] to emerge from the top of [[Koholit Rock]].{{Cite|Once you offered precious orbs to each of the three altars on the island, an ancient shrine appeared.|Adventure Log|BotW}} * During "[[The Three Giant Brothers]]" Shrine Quest, Link must collect three Ancient Orbs from three sleeping [[Hinox]]es on [[Mount Taran]]. They are located in [[Hanu Pond]], [[Uten Marsh]], and the [[Rabella Wetlands]]. Once all of these Ancient Orbs are placed in Concave Slots, [[Tawa Jinn Shrine]] will emerge from the ground.{{Cite|Offering these orbs to the matching pedestals caused an ancient shrine to appear.|Adventure Log|BotW}} The following Ancient Shrines utilize Ancient Orbs as part of their trials: * [[Bareeda Naag Shrine]] * [[Daka Tuss Shrine]] * [[Ha Dahamar Shrine]] * [[Jee Noh Shrine]] * [[Katosa Aug Shrine]] * [[Keo Ruug Shrine]] * [[Kiah Toza Shrine]] * [[Kihiro Moh Shrine]] * [[Monya Toma Shrine]] * [[Mirro Shaz Shrine]] * [[Myahm Agana Shrine]] * [[Ne'ez Yohma Shrine]] * [[Ree Dahee Shrine]] * [[Rin Oyaa Shrine]] * [[Rota Ooh Shrine]] * [[Sato Koda Shrine]] * [[Shada Naw Shrine]] * [[Shee Vaneer Shrine]] * [[Shee Venath Shrine]] * [[Sheem Dagoze Shrine]] * [[Shoda Sah Shrine]] * [[Yowaka Ita Shrine]] * [[Zalta Wa Shrine]] * [[Ze Kasho Shrine]] ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==={{EoW|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= EoW |type= Objects |category= |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Where it can be found * Whether it can be interacted with and if it is important to the story or a Quest * Whether it can be copied as an Echo }} {{Quests| {{EoW Quest |name= The Prime Energy and Null |type= Main Quest |location= [[Hyrule Castle]] }} }} {{Descriptions EoW}} {{Stub|EoW}} Ancient Orbs are mysterious artifacts found in the [[Eternal Forest]] during the [[Main Quest]] "[[The Prime Energy and Null]]".
